definitions.name: Benchmark
definitions.description: An immutable, content-addressed evaluation suite with explicit contamination edges.

definitions.name: Environment
definitions.description: An immutable, content-addressed RL environment and reward specification.

definitions.name: EvalResult
definitions.description: One immutable checkpoint verdict linked to its source run and exact benchmark version.

definitions.name: GateEpisode
definitions.description: One judged candidate against the fleet's mandatory gates: a content-addressed candidate tree, its gate results and extracted verdict, linked to its pull request.

definitions.name: Generation
definitions.description: One policy generation in a recursive self-improvement lineage, gated by an approved promotion budget.

definitions.name: MergeOutcome
definitions.description: The real-side result of one pull request: whether it actually merged.

definitions.name: Run
definitions.description: One RL run whose metric series is appended to pm history through repeatable notes.

definitions.name: Sweep
definitions.description: A declared search space and selection rule whose arms are independent child Run items.

definitions.name: Transfer
definitions.description: One measured per-metric sim-to-real gap for one checkpoint, linking both environment versions.
